reproduced_findings.summary: Non-exclusive idempotent submit transition allows two workers to call external submit for the same outbox intent.
reproduced_findings.required: exactly one worker receives external-mutation capability; loser reconciles only

reproduced_findings.summary: The same non-exclusive start pattern permits duplicate cancel/replace broker calls.
reproduced_findings.observed: 2 cancel / 2 replace invocations in race scenarios
reproduced_findings.required: exclusive mutation claim plus ambiguity-safe reconciliation

reproduced_findings.summary: Pending orders do not reserve cash or effective target exposure.
reproduced_findings.required: durable reservations included in every new-risk admission

reproduced_findings.summary: Implicit historical decision time can make old market data appear fresh when the operational caller omits an explicit clock context.
reproduced_findings.required: explicit replay clock versus operational wall/server clock contract; operational paths must never infer freshness from the data timestamp itself

reproduced_findings.summary: A failed planning/readiness state does not durably revoke dispatch of an already outboxed risk-increasing order in the canonical paper composition.
reproduced_findings.required: durable HALT/KILL/readiness gate immediately before every risk-increasing external mutation

reproduced_findings.summary: PaperOrderLifecycle accepts an approved RiskDecision without cryptographic/typed binding to the exact intent economics.
reproduced_findings.required: approval identity bound to intent id + canonical economics + revision

reproduced_findings.summary: Risk-increasing replace is not re-admitted against current limits before broker mutation.
reproduced_findings.observed: replace target 100000 reaches broker double with configured cap 110
reproduced_findings.required: recompute reserved/current exposure and re-admit every risk-increasing amendment

reproduced_findings.summary: Planning a second symbol can fail because canonical pipeline supplies a price map only for the target symbol while existing portfolio positions require valuation.
reproduced_findings.required: authoritative fresh valuation context for every held/reserved symbol

reproduced_findings.summary: ProductConfig accepts target_quantity=0 while LongOnlyMomentumStrategy construction rejects it.
A factual broker fill can be durably appended before runtime projection fails, leaving OMS/runtime/durable portfolio views divergent and replay-unrecoverable under the same assumptions.
reproduced_findings.required: immutable execution inbox plus restart-safe accounting projection/saga; factual broker executions may never be discarded to satisfy the internal model

reproduced_findings.summary: The same persisted portfolio history can be replayed with a different arbitrary opening_cash value.
reproduced_findings.required: immutable account/session genesis or explicit cash-flow ledger bound to history identity

reproduced_findings.summary: A rejected unauthenticated trade-update digest enters stream dedup before semantic authorization; exact replay can bypass stream validation while the outer raw-frame fill parser accounts it.
reproduced_findings.required: only validated/authenticated frames acquire dedup provenance; accounting must require authoritative accepted-stream provenance

release_packaging_findings.summary: Qualified wheel/sdist do not contain canonical root migrations v119/v120/v121 although current Bybit PostgreSQL modules and tests depend on them.
release_packaging_findings.fresh_pristine_sdist_targeted_test: 16 passed, 2 failed, 2 skipped; both failures are FileNotFoundError for migrations/v120/001_bybit_demo_durable_audit_lifecycle.sql
release_packaging_findings.required: release artifact self-contained for every schema/bootstrap asset used by the released code

qualification_findings.summary: Pull-request workflows report the PR branch head SHA in run metadata while actions/checkout tests refs/pull/<n>/merge, so existing wording can overstate synthetic-merge integration evidence as literal exact-head checkout evidence.
qualification_findings.applicable_pr_workflows: 6/6 SUCCESS on the exact base+head merge integration
qualification_findings.required: record candidate head and tested checkout identity separately; if literal exact-head is a policy requirement, explicitly checkout github.event.pull_request.head.sha or run a dedicated exact-head qualification mechanism
